verdict.rationale: ernd's own docs say it books travel, mentioning 'travel ernd books' and discounted airline points for customer visits and offsites, so a first-party travel-booking capability exists. Nothing shows employee self-service booking of flights and hotels in the platform, or a travel policy enforced at booking time. missing for 10: in-platform employee self-service flight and hotel booking, travel policy configuration and enforcement at booking time, hotel booking evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
